## What changed

- `kmctl review due` no longer lists a verified decision record as
  `edited after verification` only because `kmctl decision accept` changed
  its `status` from `draft` to `stable`. Any other `status` change still
  counts, and so does any other edit made with the accept. In any other
  concept, a `status` change still counts (ADR 0052, #69).

## Before you upgrade

Nothing to do. A decision record that was accepted after it was verified,
and that `kmctl review due` listed as `edited after verification` under
v0.16.0, is no longer listed, as long as the accept was its only change.

## Other changes

None.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.16.1#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.16.1
```

**Full diff**: https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl/compare/v0.16.0...v0.16.1
